# SEO keyword strategy (source of truth)

Source: Semrush AU export, prepared 16 Oct 2026 (`SEO_Keyword_Strategy_Semrush_v2.xlsx`). The CSVs here are exports of its tabs:
`page-map.csv` (one row per page: status, URL, primary and secondary keywords, title, H1, word count, publish week),
`suburb-pages.csv` (40 suburb pages in 4 tiers), `keywords.csv` (all keywords with volume, KD, CPC, target page), `action-plan.csv` (8 weeks from 19 Oct 2026).

This folder sits under `.github/`, which the FTP deploy excludes, so it is not published on the website.
Rules for using it are in the root `CLAUDE.md`, section 13.
